findings.title: Breaks resume semantics
findings.body:
The graph execution state is reset whenever any termination condition fires, not only when the graph has completed. Callers can no longer pause and continue a graph run.

Example: `MaxMessageTermination(2)`, `TokenUsageTermination`, `ExternalTermination` or `HandoffTermination` stops the flow after node A. The next `team.run()` call (without a new task, or with a follow-up task) restarts at the start nodes instead of continuing to B.

It also means `save_state()` called after a mid-graph termination stores the reset state, so the actual progress is lost.

Suggested fix: reset only when the graph actually finished, i.e. the `_StopAgent`/completion path or an empty `_ready` with no pending `_remaining`. Alternatively, reset at the start of a new task instead of on every termination.
